column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 06 (M24006): Mayling berjuang menyalakan mesin, Dandelion tumbang,
# Soppo & Robella menjadi node komunikasi baru, lalu Ateraxis muncul di dek The Elmo.
# Tetap Inggris: The Elmo, Mayling, Commander, Dandelion, Asteria, Dr. White, Persica,
# AR Team, Level II, Griffin, Soppo, Robella, RO, M16, Kalina, Leva, Lenna, Mokosh,
# Jupiter Cannon, Ateraxis, Jojo, AR-15, Neural cloud, Frame, Doll, Covenant Ring,
# Yellow Zone.
(The desperate defense by a few squads that still had combat capability bought those of us remaining on The Elmo a brief moment of respite.)
column2: (Pertahanan nekat beberapa regu yang masih punya kemampuan tempur membelikan kami yang tersisa di The Elmo sedikit waktu untuk bernapas.)

column1: (Mayling and I hurried to restart The Elmo's engine in the engine room using backup power—but since that shot destroyed about 1/3 of The Elmo's area and took many systems offline, the restart was not going smoothly.)
column2: (Aku dan Mayling bergegas menyalakan ulang mesin The Elmo di ruang mesin dengan daya cadangan—tapi karena tembakan itu menghancurkan sekitar 1/3 area The Elmo dan mematikan banyak sistem, penyalaannya tidak berjalan mulus.)

column1: What do we do, what do we do... If we can't restart it... The Elmo, please, move!
column2: Bagaimana ini, bagaimana ini... Kalau tidak bisa dinyalakan... The Elmo, kumohon, bergeraklah!

column1: (Mayling desperately tried to troubleshoot the faults, but this was no longer something she could handle alone.)
column2: (Mayling berusaha mati-matian menelusuri kerusakannya, tapi ini bukan lagi hal yang bisa dia tangani sendiri.)

column1: (No matter how automated it is or how many maintenance robots it carries, a mobile base the size of The Elmo should inherently be equipped with a more experienced maintenance crew than Mayling, especially at times like this.)
column2: (Seotomatis apa pun dan sebanyak apa pun robot perawatannya, pangkalan bergerak seukuran The Elmo semestinya dilengkapi kru perawatan yang lebih berpengalaman dari Mayling, terutama di saat seperti ini.)

column1: Mayling, don't panic. Try every method you can.
column2: Mayling, jangan panik. Coba semua cara yang kau bisa.

column1: If it still won't start, we'll consider other options.
column2: Kalau tetap tidak menyala, kita pertimbangkan opsi lain.

column1: Don't!
column2: Jangan!

column1: Other options? Does that mean abandoning The Elmo?
column2: Opsi lain? Apa itu berarti meninggalkan The Elmo?

column1: I, I don't want to give up, Commander... please don't make me give up!
column2: A-aku tidak mau menyerah, Commander... tolong jangan suruh aku menyerah!

column1: I feel the same way you do, Mayling. Calm down a bit.
column2: Perasaanku sama denganmu, Mayling. Tenang sedikit.

column1: We won't give up on the Elmo.
column2: Kita tidak akan meninggalkan Elmo.

column1: I don't know what's going on, the engine just won't start...
column2: Aku tidak tahu ada apa, mesinnya tetap tidak mau menyala...

column1: Even though the remaining energy is enough to support The Elmo's continued operation, and the engine shows no signs of damage...
column2: Padahal energi yang tersisa cukup untuk menopang The Elmo tetap beroperasi, dan mesinnya tidak menunjukkan tanda kerusakan...

column1: However...
column2: Namun...

column1: ...It's okay, Mayling.
column2: ...Tidak apa-apa, Mayling.

column1: The Elmo is so severely damaged, unknown faults could appear in many places.
column2: The Elmo rusak begitu berat, kerusakan tak terdeteksi bisa muncul di banyak tempat.

column1: If all the hardware has been checked, it might also be an emergency system lockdown caused by the bombardment.
column2: Kalau semua perangkatnya sudah diperiksa, mungkin ini penguncian sistem darurat akibat bombardir itu.

column1: Although I've been with it for ten years, there are still many unknowns...
column2: Meski aku sudah sepuluh tahun bersamanya, masih banyak yang belum kuketahui...

column1: But precisely because of this, at times like this we also have to believe it can hold on.
column2: Tapi justru karena itu, di saat seperti ini kita juga harus percaya dia bisa bertahan.

column1: Do you regret not going to Dr. White's place now?
column2: Sekarang kau menyesal tidak pergi ke tempat Dr. White?

column1: Pfft, even when I was here, the Commander turned The Elmo into this!
column2: Ih, padahal aku ada di sini, Commander tetap membuat The Elmo jadi begini!

column1: If I wasn't here, it probably would have flown into the sky by now. If I came back and saw the Elmo flying in the sky, I'd probably just faint on the spot...
column2: Kalau aku tidak di sini, mungkin dia sudah terbang ke langit sekarang. Kalau aku pulang dan melihat Elmo melayang di langit, aku mungkin langsung pingsan di tempat...

column1: That's true...
column2: Benar juga...

column1: (Mayling tightly gripped the hem of my clothes, resting her forehead against my back.)
column2: (Mayling mencengkeram kuat ujung bajuku, menyandarkan dahinya ke punggungku.)

column1: No matter how difficult it is, I will fix the Elmo.
column2: Sesulit apa pun, aku akan memperbaiki Elmo.

column1: So, Commander, you have to be well too... I can't live without the Commander and everyone.
column2: Jadi, Commander, kau juga harus baik-baik saja... Aku tidak bisa hidup tanpa Commander dan semuanya.

column1: I know the Commander said that for my own good, but... at a time like this, I'm very glad to be able to face it together with the Commander.
column2: Aku tahu Commander bilang begitu demi kebaikanku, tapi... di saat seperti ini, aku sangat senang bisa menghadapinya bersama Commander.

column1: Never, ever think about pushing me away again.
column2: Jangan pernah, sekali pun, berpikir menjauhkan aku lagi.

column1: Forever and ever, let me stay by the Commander's side, okay?
column2: Selamanya, biarkan aku tetap di sisi Commander, ya?

column1: ...Okay, thank you, Mayling.
column2: ...Baik, terima kasih, Mayling.

column1: Then hurry up and fix it. After it's fixed, I'll arrange a vacation for you.
column2: Kalau begitu cepat perbaiki. Setelah beres, aku akan mengatur cuti untukmu.

column1: You said it, Commander!
column2: Kau sudah bilang lho, Commander!

column1: Just a vacation isn't enough. I, I want to enjoy it properly. Commander, you have to push aside all your work to accompany me, go shopping with me, and, and give me a massage! You're not allowed to go play with anyone else!
column2: Cuti saja tidak cukup. A-aku mau menikmatinya dengan benar. Commander harus menyingkirkan semua pekerjaan untuk menemaniku, ikut belanja, dan, dan memijatku! Tidak boleh main dengan orang lain!

column1: The Commander said it, I'm very important too!
column2: Commander sudah bilang, aku juga sangat penting!

column1: My pleasure.
column2: Dengan senang hati.

column1: I promise you everything.
column2: Aku menjanjikan semuanya padamu.

column1: (Mayling's body is trembling slightly. I turn around and hug her comfortingly. Her small head rubs hard against my chest to wipe away her tears, blows her nose on it, and then looks up.)
column2: (Tubuh Mayling bergetar sedikit. Aku berbalik dan memeluknya untuk menenangkan. Kepala kecilnya menggosok keras ke dadaku untuk menghapus air matanya, mengembuskan hidungnya di situ, lalu mengangkat wajah.)

column1: I just thought, if the engine can't be restarted, maybe we can use other auxiliary power to push the engine to recover. I'll go try it right now!
column2: Aku baru berpikir, kalau mesinnya tidak bisa dinyalakan ulang, mungkin kita bisa memakai daya bantu lain untuk mendorong mesinnya pulih. Aku coba sekarang!

column1: (Mayling skips over to the nearby system, then stops, turns her head, and faces me with a tear-stained, flushed face.)
column2: (Mayling berjingkat ke sistem terdekat, lalu berhenti, menoleh, dan menghadapku dengan wajah merah penuh bekas air mata.)

column1: Commander, you're not allowed to lose. Leave this to me, you go to where everyone else is.
column2: Commander tidak boleh kalah. Serahkan ini padaku, kau pergi ke tempat yang lain.

column1: I... I won't give up either!
column2: A-aku juga tidak akan menyerah!

column1: I understand, Mayling.
column2: Aku paham, Mayling.

column1: (I felt Mayling's determination, nodded, and let her handle the engine.)
column2: (Aku merasakan tekad Mayling, mengangguk, dan menyerahkan urusan mesin padanya.)

column1: Sigh... honestly.
column2: Haah... yang benar saja.

column1: Putting me to work as soon as I arrive, without even spending time with me, that person really knows how to boss people around... don't you think?
column2: Baru datang langsung disuruh kerja, tanpa menemaniku sedikit pun, orang itu benar-benar pandai memerintah... iya kan?

column1: (While complaining, Dandelion quickly organizes the Neural cloud statuses of the Dolls on The Elmo. Although she is the only one remaining active and all external communications are cut off, she seems to be enjoying herself as if chatting enthusiastically with someone.)
column2: (Sambil mengeluh, Dandelion cepat menata status Neural cloud para Doll di The Elmo. Meski hanya dia yang masih aktif dan seluruh komunikasi luar terputus, dia tampak menikmatinya seperti sedang mengobrol seru dengan seseorang.)

column1: (A faint blue light and shadow flashes before her eyes.)
column2: (Cahaya dan bayang biru samar berkelebat di depan matanya.)

column1: You just love to worry.
column2: Kau memang suka khawatir.

column1: But the Commander really has it rough, with all these troubles happening at once... This counts as quite a test, doesn't it?
column2: Tapi Commander memang berat, semua masalah datang sekaligus... Ini terhitung ujian yang cukup besar, kan?

column1: Fortunately, the neural clouds of everyone he loves are fine. Next, we just need to start... Hmm?
column2: Untungnya neural cloud semua orang yang dia sayangi aman. Berikutnya kita cuma perlu mulai... Hm?

column1: (Suddenly, a violent tremor spread from the chest of Dandelion's frame. She stumbled and fell to her knees.)
column2: (Tiba-tiba getaran hebat menyebar dari dada frame Dandelion. Dia terhuyung dan jatuh bersimpuh.)

column1: Oh my, why... choose this moment?
column2: Aduh, kenapa... harus memilih saat ini?

column1: At least wait until I finish... the last step.
column2: Setidaknya tunggu sampai aku selesai... langkah terakhirnya.

column1: Phew... alright—
column2: Fyuh... baiklah—

column1: (Struggling to reach out and press the confirmation button for "automatic Frame reboot", Dandelion reveals a bitter smile.)
column2: (Susah payah mengulurkan tangan dan menekan tombol konfirmasi "reboot Frame otomatis", Dandelion menampakkan senyum pahit.)

column1: (She leaned against the console and, in an instant, closed her eyes.)
column2: (Dia bersandar ke konsol dan dalam sekejap menutup matanya.)

column1: Always making me do so many things... you have to give me a reward... Commander...
column2: Selalu menyuruhku melakukan banyak hal... kau harus memberiku hadiah... Commander...

column1: (The Elmo couldn't start, and the comms channel failed to establish. I really needed to build a new communication system.)
column2: (The Elmo tidak bisa dinyalakan, dan saluran komunikasi gagal dibangun. Aku benar-benar butuh sistem komunikasi baru.)

column1: (Although Dandelion was also there, Mayling and I had her take charge of rebooting the Dolls and preserving their neural clouds. On one hand, this was to increase our immediate combat power, and on the other hand, it was to guard against more severe damage endangering these neural cloud backups. Therefore, I asked Asteria to help establish a new comms channel.)
column2: (Meski Dandelion juga ada, aku dan Mayling memberinya tugas me-reboot para Doll dan menjaga neural cloud mereka. Di satu sisi itu untuk menambah kekuatan tempur kami sekarang, di sisi lain untuk mencegah kerusakan lebih berat membahayakan backup neural cloud itu. Karena itu aku meminta Asteria membantu membangun saluran komunikasi baru.)

column1: (I returned to the command room. Asteria was debugging, but judging from her expression, it wasn't going well.)
column2: (Aku kembali ke ruang komando. Asteria sedang menelusuri kesalahan, tapi dari ekspresinya, hasilnya tidak bagus.)

column1: Sorry, Commander... I'm afraid I can't handle this alone.
column2: Maaf, Commander... sepertinya aku tidak bisa menangani ini sendiri.

column1: The Elmo's entire communication system is completely beyond saving.
column2: Seluruh sistem komunikasi The Elmo sudah tidak bisa diselamatkan.

column1: Moreover, we are still suffering from full-band interference from the collapse storm. Even if we can barely establish a contact signal, it will probably only allow for minimal communication.
column2: Lebih dari itu, kita masih terkena gangguan seluruh pita dari badai collapse. Meski sinyal kontaknya bisa dibangun dengan susah payah, kemungkinan hanya cukup untuk komunikasi minimal.

column1: Although Persica once installed a special channel for our AR Team in Level II, allowing for barrier-free communication in various environments, that also has distance limitations.
column2: Meski Persica dulu memasang saluran khusus untuk AR Team kami di Level II, yang memungkinkan komunikasi tanpa hambatan di berbagai lingkungan, itu pun punya batas jarak.

column1: If we want to do this, we need at least one extra node as a relay. Unfortunately, the rest of the AR Team isn't here right now...
column2: Kalau mau memakainya, kita butuh setidaknya satu node tambahan sebagai relai. Sayangnya anggota AR Team yang lain tidak ada di sini sekarang...

column1: 我能帮上什么忙吗？
column2: Ada yang bisa kubantu?

column1: When I was in the military academy, I did learn a bit of communication engineering knowledge.
column2: Waktu di akademi militer, aku memang mempelajari sedikit ilmu teknik komunikasi.

column1: This isn't an ordinary line problem. Even the top communication experts can't fight against a collapse storm.
column2: Ini bukan masalah jaringan biasa. Pakar komunikasi terbaik pun tidak bisa melawan badai collapse.

column1: Unless it's that guy Dandelion, but... I think ensuring everyone's neural cloud safety is the top priority.
column2: Kecuali Dandelion, tapi... kurasa memastikan keamanan neural cloud semua orang adalah prioritas utama.

column1: Commander, I'm afraid we can only hope that Mayling can start the engine as soon as possible, move The Elmo to a place with less interference, and then find a way to establish a communication station.
column2: Commander, sepertinya kita hanya bisa berharap Mayling segera bisa menyalakan mesinnya, memindahkan The Elmo ke tempat dengan gangguan lebih kecil, lalu mencari cara membangun stasiun komunikasi.

column1: (Although we've experienced many setbacks, this time is completely different from the past.)
column2: (Meski kami sudah melewati banyak kemunduran, kali ini sepenuhnya berbeda dari yang dulu.)

column1: (In the past, no matter what desperate situation we fell into, I knew that at least on The Elmo, my family, the people I wanted to protect... everyone could live safely.)
column2: (Dulu, sedalam apa pun situasi putus asa yang kami hadapi, aku tahu setidaknya di The Elmo, keluargaku, orang-orang yang ingin kulindungi... semuanya bisa hidup dengan aman.)

column1: (But now, The Elmo, my last 'fortress', has been blown up, leaving me with no way to retreat.)
column2: (Tapi sekarang The Elmo, 'benteng' terakhirku, sudah diledakkan, membuatku tidak punya jalan mundur.)

column1: (Asteria and I looked at each other, revealing a smile that must have looked very bitter.)
column2: (Aku dan Asteria berpandangan, memperlihatkan senyum yang pasti terlihat sangat pahit.)

column1: (I don't know why, even though we haven't seen each other for ten years and we should feel somewhat like strangers to each other, I still take off those masks of feigned strength in front of her, revealing my truest self.)
column2: (Entah kenapa, meski sepuluh tahun tidak bertemu dan seharusnya kami terasa agak asing satu sama lain, aku tetap melepas semua topeng kepura-puraan kuat di depannya, memperlihatkan diriku yang paling asli.)

column1: (Asteria seems to notice my exhaustion and comes over to sit beside me.)
column2: (Asteria sepertinya menyadari kelelahanku dan datang duduk di sebelahku.)

column1: Commander, this scene seems somewhat familiar.
column2: Commander, pemandangan ini rasanya agak familier.

column1: Now that you mention it... it really is.
column2: Karena kau menyebutnya... memang iya.

column1: (Asteria's words remind me that ten years ago, we also encountered a similar predicament.)
column2: (Kata-kata Asteria mengingatkanku bahwa sepuluh tahun lalu kami juga menghadapi keadaan sulit yang serupa.)

column1: (At that time, it was also on The Elmo...)
column2: (Waktu itu juga di The Elmo...)

column1: (We were helpless in the face of a desperate situation, and could only rely on each other.)
column2: (Kami tak berdaya menghadapi situasi putus asa, dan hanya bisa saling bergantung.)

column1: But that time, not only did we survive, we also saved many comrades... saved many people.
column2: Tapi waktu itu, kami bukan cuma bertahan hidup, kami juga menyelamatkan banyak rekan... menyelamatkan banyak orang.

column1: So this time...
column2: Jadi kali ini...

column1: This time, we will definitely survive too, and safely take everyone away.
column2: Kali ini kami juga pasti bertahan, dan membawa semua orang keluar dengan aman.

column1: As expected of the Commander, unlike those two guys, always able to make people feel at ease...
column2: Memang Commander, tidak seperti dua orang itu, selalu bisa membuat orang merasa tenang...

column1: (Asteria leans on my shoulder. I don't know if Dolls feel fatigue, but I think, at this moment, with the other members of the AR Team scattered everywhere, she might have found these past ten years somewhat unbearable.)
column2: (Asteria bersandar di bahuku. Aku tidak tahu apakah Doll merasa lelah, tapi kurasa saat ini, dengan anggota AR Team lain berpencar di mana-mana, sepuluh tahun ini mungkin terasa agak berat untuknya.)

column1: (The hand reaching out to me as if searching also seems to convey her eagerness. I interlock our fingers, confirming the slightly scratched texture of the Covenant Ring on her finger that has weathered the years.)
column2: (Tangan yang terulur kepadaku seolah mencari itu juga terasa menyampaikan kerinduannya. Aku menautkan jari kami, merasakan tekstur Covenant Ring di jarinya yang sedikit tergores oleh tahun-tahun yang dilewatinya.)

column1: (At least for now, we can still rely on each other, relying on a little warmth, a little encouragement, to give each other the final, faint hope.)
column2: (Setidaknya untuk sekarang, kami masih bisa saling bergantung, bersandar pada sedikit kehangatan dan sedikit dorongan, untuk saling memberi harapan terakhir yang samar.)

column1: Commander, I—
column2: Commander, aku—

column1: ("Beep beep—" "Beep beep—")
column2: ("Bip bip—" "Bip bip—")

column1: (A rhythmic signal sound comes from somewhere unknown. I turn to look at Asteria and find that she also shows a surprised expression.)
column2: (Bunyi sinyal berirama datang dari entah di mana. Aku menoleh ke Asteria dan menemukan dia juga memasang wajah terkejut.)

column1: This is...
column2: Ini...

column1: Commander, this is—the AR Team's communication channel!
column2: Commander, ini—saluran komunikasi AR Team!

column1: (Hearing this long-lost name, my first reaction is surprise, and then a feeling of joy gradually spreads in my mind.)
column2: (Mendengar nama yang lama hilang itu, reaksi pertamaku adalah kaget, lalu rasa senang perlahan menyebar di kepalaku.)

column1: But why would the AR Team's communication channel suddenly have a response?
column2: Tapi kenapa saluran komunikasi AR Team tiba-tiba memberi respons?

column1: Wait, could it be a signal disguised by the enemy...
column2: Tunggu, jangan-jangan itu sinyal yang dipalsukan musuh...

column1: No. This communication channel of mine hasn't been used for ten years, and it uses the channel Persica built specifically for us during the Griffin era...
column2: Tidak. Saluran komunikasiku ini sudah sepuluh tahun tidak dipakai, dan memakai saluran yang dibangun Persica khusus untuk kami di era Griffin...

column1: It's impossible for our enemies to have a way to crack it specifically...
column2: Mustahil musuh kita punya cara membongkarnya secara khusus...

column1: Moreover, this channel only works at close range.
column2: Lebih dari itu, saluran ini hanya bekerja dalam jarak dekat.

column1: In that case, could it be—
column2: Kalau begitu, jangan-jangan—

column1: (Before I could voice my guess, Asteria had already connected the communication.)
column2: (Sebelum aku menyuarakan dugaanku, Asteria sudah menyambungkan komunikasinya.)

column1: Hi, 15! Long time no see!
column2: Hai, 15! Lama tidak bertemu!

column1: You must have missed me a lot without me by your side these past ten years, right?
column2: Kau pasti sangat merindukanku karena aku tidak di sisimu sepuluh tahun ini, kan?

column1: You're not allowed to say things like 'it's gotten a lot quieter around here'!
column2: Tidak boleh bilang hal seperti 'di sini jadi jauh lebih tenang'!

column1: ...Then I have nothing to say.
column2: ...Kalau begitu aku tidak punya apa-apa untuk dikatakan.

column1: Waaah—that's so mean!
column2: Huweee—kejam sekali!

column1: Robella, hurry up and say something to her!
column2: Robella, cepat katakan sesuatu padanya!

column1: I... I don't know what to say...
column2: A-aku tidak tahu harus bilang apa...

column1: But it's really great that you're back...
column2: Tapi benar-benar bagus kau sudah kembali...

column1: RO, since when did you become so sentimental... honestly.
column2: RO, sejak kapan kau jadi begitu sentimental... yang benar saja.

column1: Don't cry in front of me, I won't know how to respond.
column2: Jangan menangis di depanku, aku tidak akan tahu harus bagaimana.

column1: S-sorry...
column2: M-maaf...

column1: By the way, how did you know I was here?
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, bagaimana kalian tahu aku di sini?

column1: Actually, it's because... we originally wanted to go to Mokosh with Kalina to find the Commander, but we ran into M16 on the way.
column2: Sebenarnya karena... kami awalnya mau pergi ke Mokosh bersama Kalina untuk mencari Commander, tapi di jalan bertemu M16.

column1: Because the battle in Mokosh is very tense, she guided us to take the supplies to the thermal power plant first, and also said... someone is already heading towards the Commander to help.
column2: Karena pertempuran di Mokosh sangat tegang, dia mengarahkan kami membawa pasokannya ke pembangkit listrik termal dulu, dan juga bilang... sudah ada yang menuju ke Commander untuk membantu.

column1: ...It really was leaked by that guy.
column2: ...Ternyata memang dia yang membocorkannya.

column1: Honestly, 15 is only willing to contact Sis 16!
column2: Yang benar saja, 15 cuma mau menghubungi Sis 16!

column1: But Robella and I miss you very much too!
column2: Padahal aku dan Robella juga sangat merindukanmu!

column1: I actually also...
column2: Sebenarnya aku juga...

column1: 不，没什么。
column2: Tidak, bukan apa-apa.

column1: Hehe, I heard that~
column2: Hehe, aku dengar itu~

column1: 听到什么？
column2: Mendengar apa?

column1: Hearing you say that you miss everyone too!
column2: Mendengarmu bilang kau juga merindukan semuanya!

column1: Don't forget, the AR Team can hear each other's inner voices!
column2: Jangan lupa, AR Team bisa mendengar suara hati satu sama lain!

column1: Does that function really exist? Don't let Persica fool you...
column2: Fungsi itu benar-benar ada? Jangan sampai kau dibodohi Persica...

column1: (Before Asteria could finish, I saw Soppo waving at me exaggeratedly.)
column2: (Sebelum Asteria selesai, aku melihat Soppo melambai ke arahku dengan berlebihan.)

column1: Hey, Commander~! I knew you were here too!
column2: Hei, Commander~! Sudah kuduga kau juga ada di sini!

column1: I have good news for you, we successfully escorted Kalina to a safe place!
column2: Ada kabar baik untukmu, kami berhasil mengantar Kalina ke tempat yang aman!

column1: How did Kalina... M16?
column2: Bagaimana Kalina bisa... M16?

column1: (My brain was a bit confused. Although it was also related to my recent exhaustion and injuries, the thought of the AR Team and Kalina appearing in the Yellow Zone at the same time made my consciousness a bit dazed.)
column2: (Kepalaku agak kacau. Meski itu juga berkaitan dengan kelelahan dan luka-lukaku, memikirkan AR Team dan Kalina muncul di Yellow Zone pada waktu yang sama membuat kesadaranku agak melayang.)

column1: (As if pulled back to a certain moment in the past by fate.)
column2: (Seolah ditarik takdir kembali ke satu momen di masa lalu.)

column1: Commander, do you still not understand? In order to catch up with your footsteps, neither Kalina nor we will stop.
column2: Commander, kau masih belum paham? Demi menyusul langkahmu, Kalina maupun kami tidak akan berhenti.

column1: Thank you... But the current situation is very chaotic. You must ensure Kalina stays in a safe place.
column2: Terima kasih... Tapi situasi sekarang sangat kacau. Kalian harus memastikan Kalina tetap di tempat yang aman.

column1: Rest assured, Kalina has Leva and Lenna taking care of her, she'll be fine.
column2: Tenang saja, Kalina dijaga Leva dan Lenna, dia akan aman.

column1: So as soon as we got them to a safe location, Soppo and I rushed over here.
column2: Jadi begitu mereka sampai di lokasi aman, aku dan Soppo bergegas kemari.

column1: By the way, how are things on your end now?
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, bagaimana keadaan di sana sekarang?

column1: Uh, it doesn't look too good...
column2: Eh, kelihatannya tidak terlalu bagus...

column1: (Robella seemed to have seen the ruined scene on The Elmo through Asteria's vision.)
column2: (Robella sepertinya melihat pemandangan hancur di The Elmo melalui penglihatan Asteria.)

column1: The situation here isn't very good.
column2: Situasi di sini tidak begitu bagus.

column1: The military just used a Jupiter Cannon to snipe The Elmo... Although we managed to avoid a critical hit in time, the backup engine won't start now, and we have no way to contact the combat squads outside.
column2: Militer baru saja memakai Jupiter Cannon untuk menembak The Elmo... Meski kami berhasil menghindari hantaman kritis tepat waktu, mesin cadangannya sekarang tidak mau menyala, dan kami tidak punya cara menghubungi regu tempur di luar.

column1: But now that you're here, things are different.
column2: Tapi karena kalian sudah di sini, keadaannya berbeda.

column1: Asteria, are you saying...!
column2: Asteria, maksudmu...!

column1: Yes.
column2: Benar.

column1: Commander, remember? I just said that we can forcibly establish a comms channel through the AR Team's Level II access, we just need an extra node as a contact key to build a new internal communication platform.
column2: Commander, ingat? Aku baru bilang kita bisa memaksa membangun saluran komunikasi lewat akses Level II AR Team, kita cuma butuh satu node tambahan sebagai kunci kontak untuk membangun platform komunikasi internal baru.

column1: Now we have two extra nodes.
column2: Sekarang kita punya dua node tambahan.

column1: What the heck, in the end you're just treating us as backup nodes...
column2: Apa-apaan, ujung-ujungnya kau memperlakukan kami cuma sebagai node cadangan...

column1: But, even as a backup node, at least it shows I'm very useful!
column2: Tapi, meski cuma node cadangan, setidaknya itu menunjukkan aku sangat berguna!

column1: Yeah, you're the key to saving The Elmo right now.
column2: Iya, kalian kunci penyelamat The Elmo sekarang.

column1: Alright, I need to connect to Level II as soon as possible.
column2: Baik, aku harus menyambung ke Level II secepat mungkin.

column1: Soppo, wait for my contact signal.
column2: Soppo, tunggu sinyal kontakku.

column1: Robella, please monitor the surrounding signal networks, I—
column2: Robella, tolong pantau jaringan sinyal di sekitar, aku—

column1: No need.
column2: Tidak perlu.

column1: (A figure silently appeared behind us, and in her arms was Dandelion's unconscious body.)
column2: (Sebuah figur muncul tanpa suara di belakang kami, dan di pelukannya ada tubuh Dandelion yang tidak sadarkan diri.)

column1: (The girl was like a ghost, stepping onto the Elmo's ruined deck.)
column2: (Gadis itu seperti hantu, melangkah ke dek Elmo yang hancur.)

column1: (No one knew when she appeared. Even the usually alert Asteria didn't notice the slightest abnormal intrusion.)
column2: (Tidak ada yang tahu kapan dia muncul. Bahkan Asteria yang biasanya waspada tidak menyadari penyusupan ganjil sedikit pun.)

column1: (Until she appeared behind us.)
column2: (Sampai dia muncul di belakang kami.)

column1: —It's that guy! Ateraxis!
column2: —Itu dia! Ateraxis!

column1: You... what did you do to her!
column2: Kau... apa yang kau lakukan padanya!

column1: I didn't do anything.
column2: Aku tidak melakukan apa pun.

column1: When I found her, she had already collapsed. It didn't look like she had crashed.
column2: Saat kutemukan, dia sudah tumbang. Tidak kelihatan seperti sistemnya crash.

column1: She has a very special aura about her, so I protected her. Now I'm handing her over to you, Commander, please catch her.
column2: Ada aura yang sangat khusus di dirinya, jadi aku melindunginya. Sekarang kuserahkan padamu, Commander, tolong terima dia.

column1: (Ateraxis walked up to me. I had Asteria stay on guard and reached out to take Dandelion's Frame.)
column2: (Ateraxis melangkah ke arahku. Aku menyuruh Asteria tetap waspada dan mengulurkan tangan menerima Frame Dandelion.)

column1: (Her eyes were tightly closed, but her body was accompanied by a slight, unnatural tremor. This fragile posture was something I hadn't seen in recent years.)
column2: (Matanya terpejam rapat, tapi tubuhnya diikuti getaran kecil yang tidak wajar. Postur rapuh seperti itu belum pernah kulihat beberapa tahun ini.)

column1: (The fact that Dandelion would fall was already very unusual. Indeed, Ateraxis possessed combat power surpassing Dandelion's Frame, but there was truly no damage on her body, not looking like she had been through a battle.)
column2: (Fakta bahwa Dandelion bisa tumbang saja sudah sangat aneh. Ateraxis memang punya kekuatan tempur melebihi Frame Dandelion, tapi di tubuhnya benar-benar tidak ada kerusakan, tidak tampak seperti habis melewati pertempuran.)

column1: (And for some reason, I felt that Ateraxis wouldn't lie.)
column2: (Dan entah kenapa, aku merasa Ateraxis tidak akan berbohong.)

column1: This girl—of all times, right when we need her the most...
column2: Anak ini—dari semua waktu, justru saat kami paling membutuhkannya...

column1: Have you finished confirming? Allow me to reiterate: as long as the situation permits, I will not harm any of your subordinates, Commander.
column2: Sudah selesai memastikannya? Izinkan aku mengulangi: selama situasinya memungkinkan, aku tidak akan melukai satu pun bawahanmu, Commander.

column1: As long as you know your limits, this will be a decent meeting.
column2: Selama kau tahu batasmu, ini akan jadi pertemuan yang layak.

column1: This is our The Elmo, and you are not welcome here at all.
column2: Ini The Elmo milik kami, dan kau sama sekali tidak diterima di sini.

column1: You also have the same aura as her... Oh right, you're the one who shot down Jojo—my dragon, right?
column2: Kau juga punya aura yang sama dengannya... Oh iya, kau yang menjatuhkan Jojo—nagaku, kan?

column1: So that was your pet. Yes, I did it.
column2: Jadi itu hewan peliharaanmu. Benar, aku yang melakukannya.

column1: 15, protect the Commander, we'll be right there!
column2: 15, lindungi Commander, kami segera datang!

column1: I see, you're AR-15... If you want to stop me, who could be more suitable candidates than you?
column2: Begitu, kau AR-15... Kalau ingin menghentikanku, siapa lagi yang lebih pantas dari kalian?

column1: Everyone in the AR Team—
column2: Semua anggota AR Team—

column1: Nice to meet you.
column2: Senang berjumpa.
